# M4 metrics: events and plays (synthetic)

**Synthetic data only.** Re-measured 2026-10-06 on hfbox. Numbers: `metrics.json` (generated by
`eval/split.py`). The scripts that produced them are in `eval/`. M1 and M5 use the same runs.

## Code state

The laptop working tree at HEAD `5b5bd2b`, plus uncommitted work in progress. These courtcam
files differ from HEAD: `detect.py`, `pose.py`, `triggers.py`, `pyproject.toml`, `README.md` and
`tests/test_pipeline.py`, plus the new `extras.py`. The source changes only add import guards
for the optional extras, so none of them changes detection, pose, events, triggers or plays.

## Data

Nine 90 s clips, generated during this run by `courtcam synth --duration 90` (1280x720, 30 fps):

- basketball half court, seeds 7 and 11
- basketball full court, seed 7
- badminton doubles, seeds 7 and 11
- pickleball doubles, seeds 7 and 11
- volleyball indoor, seeds 7 and 11

The voice lines come from `samples/synthetic/voice`.

## Commands

Run these on the box, from a copy of the tree:

```bash
mkdir -p _m && cp docs/evidence/M4/eval/* _m/
bash _m/run_metrics.sh gen    # courtcam synth, 9 clips
bash _m/run_metrics.sh gt     # synthetic detector + GT poses (run1.py), whisper-small triggers (run_trig.py), eval_synth.py
bash _m/run_metrics.sh yolo   # YOLO detect (yolo11m) + YOLO pose (yolo11m-pose), same triggers and eval
bash _m/run_metrics.sh vit    # rerun.py: pose -> plays again on the YOLO tracks with ViTPose (vitpose-base-simple)
bash _m/run_metrics.sh mot    # courtcam eval (CLEAR-MOT / IDF1) on the five seed-7 scenes, for M1
python _m/agg.py _m/out > _m/agg.json && python _m/split.py _m/agg.json <dest> _m/meta.json
```

`eval_synth.py` (taken from the accuracy pass) matches events to the synthetic truth with
these windows:

- **Shots:** ±1.5 s to the ball at the rim.
- **Possession changes:** ±2.5 s, same team.
- **Points:** ±1.5 s.
- **Contacts:** ±0.15 s.
- **Rallies and plays:** temporal IoU ≥ 0.5. Plays use the sport's primary grammar.

## Results (9 clips)

| item | synthetic detector + GT poses | YOLO detect + YOLO pose |
|---|---|---|
| shots | 18 TP, P 1.00, R 0.67; 2-vs-3 points right 18/18 | 21 TP, P 1.00, R 0.78; points right 14/21 |
| shots, half court only (20) | 16/20 | 18/20 |
| possession change | P 0.83, R 0.80 (24 TP) | P 0.76, R 0.73 (22 TP) |
| plays | P 0.83, R 0.79 | P 0.80, R 0.78 |
| contacts | P 0.91, R 0.89 | P 0.91, R 0.90 |
| rallies | P 0.73, R 0.67 | P 0.75, R 0.69 |
| volleyball attack | P 0.30, R 0.50 | P 0.10, R 0.17 |

## Accuracy pass (current code only)

These are "after" values only. The accuracy pass's "before" numbers (shots 5/27 and so on) were
measured on older code and are history; this run cannot reproduce them.

| item | YOLO pose (default) | `--pose vit` |
|---|---|---|
| shots (27) | 21 TP, P 1.00, R 0.78 | 19 TP, P 1.00, R 0.70 |
| shots, half court (20) | 18/20 | 17/20 |
| point `winner_side` right / known | 27/33 | 24/33 |
| possession change | 22 TP, P 0.76 | 22 TP, P 0.76 |
